retrieval_targets.scope: Local Qdrant 1.18 collections built from the restored bundle 549af2ed... with local MiniLM vectors, checked against restored Postgres. Row points equal database rows (101 games, 2,950 box-score rows, 101 reports, 15,864 possessions); archive-unit points are counted separately. Every payload carries the release version. Not cloud inference, not remote collections, aliases not promoted.

retrieval_filters.scope: One sampled value per filter (game, date, team, player, period where present) per collection, with production-default filter semantics (archive-unit filters off): Qdrant exact count equals an independent count over the stored payloads. Wrong-release exclusion is checked against a nonexistent version string.

warm_load.scope: Pre-promotion configuration only (shadow at 10%, evidence loop on, deterministic delivery; the load tool sends no turn_id, so no request reaches the model). Local restore of bundle 549af2ed..., Qdrant and providers off. Ten distinct analyst questions plus ten archive readers for 30 s. The llm_primary launch configuration was measured separately in llm-primary-load.json and does NOT meet the 4 s analyst p95: see observations.llm_primary_latency.

rollback.scope: Read-only capture of the live deployments, active data version and Qdrant aliases. It is not a restore rehearsal or a database backup.

review_policy: Agents audit every report. Owner approves template, exceptions, final hash-bound audit summary and evaluation labels in batches. Unresolved checks block release.

observations.note: Only explicit check entries establish exact-commit gate evidence. Other observations retain their stated scope and limitations.

border_followup.verification: Production frontend build, 2 report browser tests, formatting, empty detector result, desktop/mobile inspection with no overflow. Earlier full-suite evidence retains its original tested commit.
